description: Create a custom VSCode user snippet for React functional components. The snippet must: (1) be accessible in .jsx/.tsx files, (2) trigger with prefix 'rfc', (3) have description 'React Functional Component with TypeScript and hooks', (4) generate a template containing: a TypeScript interface for props (with at least one property), a functional component declaration using React.FC with the interface, at least one useState hook, a JSX return statement with some content, and a default export. Use VSCode's Command Palette (Ctrl+Shift+P) to access 'Snippets: Configure User Snippets', then select 'typescriptreact.json' or 'javascriptreact.json'. The snippet body should use VSCode placeholder syntax ($1, $2, etc.) for tab stops. Example structure: interface with props -> const Component: React.FC -> useState hook -> return JSX -> export default.

metadata.real_world_scenario: Developer creates custom snippet to eliminate repetitive React component boilerplate
